scope: Geometry-preserving refactor; nominal CAD, native controls, motion/service and exports only. No physical, electrical or flight qualification.

independent_design_review.scope: Unchanged historical BP fixture approval; current refactor validated by fresh tests and strict comparison, not a new independent design approval.

current_source_review.scope: Current code review only; embedded targeted tests are preliminary, separate from the full native release phase.

native_tests.execution: Complete native unittest discovery grouped by TestCase class across six isolated FreeCAD Python workers. Class fixtures preserved; exact discovery ID coverage, no skips, frozen production/test/tool sources required.
native_tests.source_unchanged_scope: Complete frozen native phase: production/test/tool Python, fixture and execution-script hashes match before, after and recording.
native_tests.launcher_scope: Observed subprocess return code for this refactor native wrapper. Native harness ran in its own session; result data and logs are independently hashed. No prior-run exception is reused.

blender_scope: Sampled prescribed rigid motion, not physical/dynamic/wire simulation.
record_scope: Execution result at recorded_utc; valid only for matching source, native CAD and fixture hashes. Absent generated files must be regenerated and revalidated.
